findings.location: Gaza Strip; shipments from Egypt through Israeli-controlled entry procedures
findings.affected_population_system: Humanitarian food distribution, cooked-meal recipients and subsidized bread production
findings.event_date_context: Israeli notification on November 1 of suspension of humanitarian and commercial shipments from Egypt, with exceptions; projected impact reported November 6.
findings.finding_summary: OCHA reports that continued suspension of supplies from Egypt could cut free cooked-meal distribution from about 600,000 to 330,000 meals per day (about 45%); bread output could fall from 280 to 259 tonnes daily. Conditional Food Security Sector forecast, not a measured reduction.
findings.section: Gaza Strip, paragraphs on Egypt shipments and Food Security Sector
findings.evidence_basis: OCHA Gaza section, lines 98-99; report highlights lines 17-20.

findings.affected_population_system: Water, sewage and floodwater pumping systems; generator-dependent health equipment and ambulance logistics at risk
findings.event_date_context: Coastal Municipalities Water Utility warned of cascading system failures November 1; report describes existing pump failures and other health/transport systems as at risk.
findings.finding_summary: OCHA says floodwater and sewage pumps are already failing amid restrictions and shortages of engine oil, lubricants, spare parts and generator supplies. Neonatal/adult ventilators, cold chain and ambulances face potential disruption; these latter interruptions are risks, not verified outages.
findings.section: Shortages of engine oil threaten critical services

findings.event_date_context: Shelter Cluster needs and in-Gaza stocks as of November 1, newly published by OCHA November 6.
findings.finding_summary: Shelter Cluster estimates approximately 121,000 tents, 561,000 tarpaulins, 57,000 emergency shelter kits and 1.7 million mattresses needed for winter; in-Gaza stocks approximately 2,800 tents and 4,993 mattresses with no emergency shelter kits. These are stock/need assessments, not new displacement totals.
